description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330005296246 GASKET: Line 0001 Qty 394 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0097 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 59. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 77969 4770; 79U29 2-52924-1; 83259 010858. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
